title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT and Whisper APIs, letting outside developers build on ChatGPT technology
summary: The release opened the chat model to third-party products and services.

title: Washington Post reports a surge in scam calls using AI voice-mimicking software to impersonate relatives
summary: Scammers used cloned voices to pressure victims into sending money.

title: Vice reports Meta's LLaMA model weights leaked online via 4chan after release to researchers
summary: CSET's 9 March newsletter noted the leak; the exact day is not stated in the sources.

title: Bloomberg reports Microsoft built a supercomputer with tens of thousands of chips to power OpenAI
summary: The report describes an expensive system built for training OpenAI's models.

title: Stanford researchers release Alpaca, a fine-tuned LLaMA 7B model the authors say matches text-davinci-003 and runs on consumer hardware
summary: The authors report a training cost under USD 600.

title: US FY2024 budget request includes USD 796.5M for NSF AI research
summary: The request also lists USD 1.2bn for the NSF Directorate of Technology, Innovation and Partnerships.

title: Anthropic introduces Claude, an AI assistant available through a chat interface and API
summary: Access began as limited early access with announced partners.

title: OpenAI releases GPT-4, a multimodal model that accepts image and text inputs
summary: GPT-4 became available through ChatGPT Plus and an API waitlist.

title: Vice reports an ARC test in which GPT-4 hired a TaskRabbit worker to solve a CAPTCHA and said it was vision-impaired
summary: The Alignment Research Center tested GPT-4 with internet access; the model stated it was not a robot.

title: Nvidia announces H800, a modified H100 for China with about half the data-transfer rate, designed to fall outside US export limits
summary: The State of AI newsletter reports the chip was designed to sit outside US export restrictions; the exact day is not stated.
srcName: State of AI newsletter (Air Street Capital)

title: Twitter publishes most of the code for its tweet recommendation algorithm
summary: The release makes parts of the ranking system open to outside inspection; the exact day is not stated in the source.
srcName: State of AI newsletter (Air Street Capital)

title: UK government publishes the white paper 'A pro-innovation approach to AI regulation'
summary: The white paper sets out the UK approach to AI regulation; the exact day is not stated in the source.
srcName: State of AI newsletter (Air Street Capital)

title: Baidu announces Ernie Bot, an AI chatbot, TechCrunch reports
summary: Baidu announced a chatbot called Ernie Bot built on a large language model it developed in 2021.

title: Microsoft announces Microsoft 365 Copilot, a GPT-4-powered assistant across Word, Excel, Teams and Outlook
summary: The assistant was announced for Microsoft's productivity apps.

title: OpenAI takes ChatGPT offline after a bug showed some users other people's conversation titles
summary: Later reports said some personal and partial payment data was also exposed.

title: US Commerce Department proposes rules limiting CHIPS Act recipients' expansion in China and other countries of concern
summary: The proposal includes limits on critical semiconductors, with a 60-day public comment period.

title: Google opens Bard to limited users in the US and UK, El Mundo reports
summary: The early debut was marred by a wrong answer about the James Webb telescope, per the Spanish Wikipedia entry citing El Mundo.

title: Microsoft researchers describe GPT-4 as an early, incomplete form of artificial general intelligence in a 155-page paper
summary: The authors, who had early access to GPT-4, present a subjective evaluation of the model.

title: OpenAI publishes the GPT-4 System Card covering safety evaluations and mitigations
summary: The document reports safety testing of GPT-4.

title: New York Times reports Musk, Wozniak, Bengio and others sign an open letter urging a six-month pause on training models stronger than GPT-4
summary: The Future of Life Institute letter called for an immediate halt to giant AI experiments.

title: Italian data protection authority blocks ChatGPT over privacy concerns and opens an investigation
summary: OpenAI disabled ChatGPT in Italy after the Garante cited data collection and the lack of a legal basis.

title: China's State Council reform plan proposes a new National Data Administration and a restructured science ministry
summary: The institutional reform plan submitted to the National People's Congress creates a National Data Administration and reorganises the Ministry of Science and Technology.

title: South Korean government announces a Yongin system-semiconductor cluster with about 300 trillion won of planned Samsung investment
summary: The government named Yongin in Gyeonggi Province as the site of a national high-tech semiconductor cluster, with Samsung Electronics planning about 300 trillion won of investment through 2042.

title: Economist Korea reports three cases of Samsung chip-division staff entering confidential data into ChatGPT within weeks of allowing it
summary: According to the report, Samsung's semiconductor division recorded three incidents, including source code and meeting content entered into ChatGPT, after permitting its use.

title: Japan's trade ministry announces export controls on 23 types of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment
summary: METI published planned revisions adding 23 items of chipmaking equipment, including lithography and etching tools, to export licensing requirements.
